title: Goods of the hunt
creator: core
description: The five goods classes of the hunt (docs/design/HUNTING.md section 6) and the goods of the hare, the roe deer and the wolf, drawn with stand-ins from existing art until their own drawings land.

classes.name: Meat
classes.description: Raw and cooked flesh. Raw, it is food that heals a little and spoils with the carcass.

classes.name: Hide
classes.description: Skins and pelts, scraped and tanned into leather.

classes.name: Bone
classes.description: Bones, antlers, teeth and claws: needles, handles and charms.

classes.name: Sinew
classes.description: Tendon: the cord and the bowstring.

classes.name: Feather
classes.description: Plumes and down: fletching and finery.

items.name: Hare meat
items.description: Lean raw meat off a hare. It heals a little and spoils with the carcass.

items.name: Hare hide
items.description: A small soft skin, scraped for a lining or a cord's wrap.

items.name: Hare bone
items.description: Light bones for needles and small handles.

items.name: Roe meat
items.description: Raw venison off a roe deer. It heals a little and spoils with the carcass.

items.name: Roe hide
items.description: A supple roe skin, the first leather.

items.name: Roe bone
items.description: Long bones for handles and awls.

items.name: Roe sinew
items.description: Tendon off a roe deer: the cord and the first bowstring.

items.name: Wolf fang
items.description: A long fang, for a charm or a fine point.

items.name: Wolf meat
items.description: Tough raw meat. It heals a little and spoils with the carcass.
